protocol: RSAF pilot in a single-seat Hawker Hunter on a routine training flight. The pilot reported a cockpit pressurization warning at 30,000 ft aircraft altitude. Cabin pressure history and the number exposed are unavailable.
outcome_window: In-flight onset, assessment after landing, treatment and follow-up of unspecified duration.
note: The authors considered DCS most likely. In-flight findings included occipital pain, visual phenomena, disorientation and slurred speech. Sensory and hip or knee symptoms evolved after landing. This selected aircraft case is distinct from the chamber trainee in Case No. 2.
